original: 「背高いの羨ましい」「そう？ でも背高くてもいいことなんて何もないよ。天井に頭ぶつけたりするし」

en.text: "I'm jealous of your height." "Really? There's nothing good about being tall. You hit your head on the ceiling and all that."
"It must be great to be tall." "Do you think so? It's not really that great. You keep bumping your head on the ceiling."
